name: margyn
description: MARGYN — Read, don't count. Mindful reading with a writable margin.

scripts.electron:dev: concurrently -k "npm run dev -- -p 3000" "wait-on http://localhost:3000 && cross-env ELECTRON_START_URL=http://localhost:3000 NODE_ENV=development electron ."
scripts.electron:build:win: cross-env NODE_ENV=production CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false next build && electron-builder --win
scripts.electron:build:mac: cross-env NODE_ENV=production CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false next build && electron-builder --mac
scripts.electron:build:all: cross-env NODE_ENV=production CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false next build && electron-builder --win --mac
scripts.postinstall: node scripts/copy-wasm.js && node scripts/patch-electron-builder.js && electron-builder install-app-deps
